decision.owner: Ray noun 1 (beam), definition of the compound Roentgen/Rontgen ray
decision.old:
a form of electromagnetic radiation generated in a very highly exhausted vacuum tube by an electrical discharge; now more commonly called
X-ray
. It is composed of electromagnetic radiation of wavelength shorter than that of ultraviolet light but longer than that of gamma rays. It is capable of passing through many bodies opaque to light, and producing photographic and fluorescent effects by which means pictures showing the internal structure of opaque objects are made, called X-rays, radiographs, sciagraphs, X-ray photographs, radiograms. So called from the discoverer,
W. C.
Röntgen
.
